gameVersion.note: Final Classic Era state — post-Phase 6 (Naxxramas released); all pre-TBC items, enchants, and recipes available. NOT SoD, NOT Anniversary progression, NOT TBC. Same value across all brackets.

xpLock.note: Classic Era has no in-game XP-off toggle. XP must be managed manually; BGs award no XP, but mob and quest XP can still ding you past 19. Stop turning in XP quests near the cap, avoid killing mobs that would ding you, and complete only gear-reward quests whose XP won't overflow.
